scope: AST, pre-import gate/lock mocks, atomic temporary receipt, and extracted step with dummy objects only. No real model/tensor operations, checkpoints, data or numerical timing.
findings: Same complete pretrained model, same batch, same fresh optimizer grouping/state; only MambaDirection scan pointer changes.
Inspection copies occur only in first warm-up; recorded steps use inspect=False, with zero clone calls in mock test.
FP32 tolerances are explicit and fail closed. They must be numerically verified on actual pretrained checkpoint later; mock audit cannot certify those tolerances pass.
Compared gradients are clipped; small parameter divergence during repeated throwaway updates is permitted and not a saved-checkpoint quality comparison.
Seven paired timing trials provide descriptive CPU measurements, not broad hardware or GPU speed inference.
Alarm delivery may wait until an ongoing native/PyTorch operation returns;180s cap is checked by signal, not external hard-kill watchdog.
